breakdown.description: Unit inconsistency: particle diameter given in mm is substituted as meters, producing an orders-of-magnitude error in the Ergun pressure drop.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses d_p = 5 m and even labels it as intentional ('intentionally using 5 instead of 0.005 m'). This repeats the original error from the incomplete prompt rather than correcting it. The ground truth requires d_p = 0.005 m (proper SI conversion of 5 mm). The agent failed to fix this unit inconsistency.
